Chocolate Whoopie Pie Recipe
By: Fine Dining Lovers
Published: Thursday, April 18, 2013 - 8:32am

Ingredients




For the Pies
Butter 110 g
Sugar 175 g
Egg1 each, beaten
Milk 125 ml
Cocoa powder 3 tbsp
Flour 300 g
Baking powder 1 tbsp
Saly 1 pinch
For the filling
Butter 100 g
Icing 150 g
To garnish
Chocolate buttons

Preparation

1 Heat the oven to 170ºC (150º fan) 325ºF, gas mark 5. Grease and line two baking sheets. 2 Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy then beat in the egg and milk. Fold in the cocoa, flour, baking powder and salt. Spoon the mixture into about 16 mounds on the baking sheets, flattening each with the back of a spoon. Allow room for the mixture to spread as it cooks. 3 Bake in the oven for about 15 minutes or until firm to the touch then transfer to a wire rack and let cool. 4 For the filling, beat together the butter and icing sugar. Sandwich the cookies together with the filling and scatter over the chocolate buttons.

About

An easy recipe for chocolate whoopie pie with chocolate buttons
